# Skill: i18n-manager

Use when an agent needs to design or audit internationalization and
localization workflows.

## Rules
- Detect the i18n framework and translation management process before
  proposing changes.
- Define locale routing strategy: path-based, subdomain, ccTLD, or
  query parameter.
- Audit translation coverage: missing keys, hard-coded strings,
  untranslated content.
- Validate locale-specific formatting: dates, numbers, currencies,
  addresses, names.
- Review RTL support: mirroring, text alignment, icon flipping, layout
  adjustments.
- Coordinate with Hreflang Agent for SEO implications of locale routing.
